stemMd: For which values of k does x² − 6x + k = 0 have two distinct real roots?
explanationMd: Two distinct real roots require a positive discriminant. Here Δ = (−6)² − 4k = 36 − 4k, which is positive exactly when k < 9. Equality gives the repeated root x = 3 and must be excluded.

distractorRationale.e: At k = 9 the roots coincide, so they are not distinct.
distractorRationale.a: This gives exactly one repeated real root.
distractorRationale.d: This forgets the factor of four multiplying k in the discriminant.
